crossRefs.note: A faithful man is rich with blessings; but one who is eager to be rich will not go unpunished.
crossRefs.keyword: that hasteth, etc. Heb. that hath an evil eye, hasteth to berich

crossRefs.note: But those who are determined to be rich fall into a temptation, a snare, and many foolish and harmful lusts, such as…
crossRefs.keyword: that hasteth, etc. Heb. that hath an evil eye, hasteth to berich

crossRefs.note: Don’t eat the food of him who has a stingy eye, and don’t crave his delicacies:
Isn’t it lawful for me to do what I want to with what I own? Or is your eye evil, because I am good?’
covetings, wickedness, deceit, lustful desires, an evil eye, blasphemy, pride, and foolishness.
Lot lifted up his eyes, and saw all the plain of the Jordan, that it was well-watered everywhere, before Yahweh…
It came to pass, when they had taken them out, that he said, “Escape for your life! Don’t look behind you, and don’t…
He will restore that for which he labored, and will not swallow it down. He will not rejoice according to the substance…
Though he heap up silver as the dust, and prepare clothing as the clay;
he may prepare it, but the just will put it on, and the innocent will divide the silver.

translations.web: A stingy man hurries after riches, and doesn’t know that poverty waits for him.
translations.bsb: A stingy man hastens after wealth and does not know that poverty awaits him.
translations.kjv: He that hasteth to be rich hath an evil eye, and considereth not that poverty shall come
translations.asv: he that hath an evil eye hasteth after riches, And knoweth not that want shall come upon him.
